name: Long-Term Residence (Automatic Entitlement by Years in Morocco)

requirements.blocker_text: 10 years of legal residence in Morocco under a regular residence card entitles the holder to automatic renewal/upgrade under Article 17 of Law 02-03.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 10 years of legal residence under a regular residence card.

requirements.blocker_text: 15 years of continuous residence in Morocco (evidenced by any means -- utility bills, medical records, testimonies), regardless of legal status during that time, or residence since age 10.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 10 years' legal residence, OR 15 years' continuous presence by any evidentiary means

sources.title: GADEM legal guide -- Article 17 of Law 02-03, automatic entitlement for long-term residents: 15 years' continuous residence (any evidentiary means) or residence since age 10, or 10 years' legal residence

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Morocco). STATUS: DRAFT -- sourced to GADEM's Article 17 summary, not an independently verified primary legislative text. citizenship_after_months modeled 0 since by the time either threshold is met (10 or 15 years), the applicant will already exceed ma_naturalisation.json's 5-year residence bar many times over -- this route functions as an upgrade to a longer-duration, more secure residence card rather than a distinct step in the citizenship timeline. This is Morocco's closest equivalent to a 'permanent residence' status in this dataset's schema, though structurally it remains a renewable long-duration card (up to 10 years) rather than a formally indefinite permit.
